# pvecli node maintenance

Prepare a node for manual maintenance, then bring it back.

## enter

Empty a node and protect the cluster before working on it by hand.

Moves its guests away, sets the Ceph noout flag (so its OSDs going down
trigger no rebalance) and records what it did. Upgrade or reboot the
node yourself, then run `node maintenance exit`.

```text
pvecli node maintenance enter NODE [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node going into maintenance. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-t`, `--target VALUE` | Node receiving its guests (default: most free memory). |
| `--with-local-disks` | Copy local disks during live migrations. |
| `--no-ceph-flag` | Do not set the Ceph noout flag. |
| `-y`, `--yes` | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## exit

Bring a node back: check the cluster, clear noout, move its guests home.

```text
pvecli node maintenance exit NODE [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `NODE` | Node coming back from maintenance. |

### Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--no-return` |  | Leave the guests where they are. |
| `--wait N` | `600` | Seconds to wait for the node to be online again. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile to use. |

## status

Nodes currently in maintenance, from the records pvecli keeps.

```text
pvecli node maintenance status
```
